scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 23 supersedes attempt 22 after aligning the staged release validators with the intentionally retired legacy Web DOM cursor. Settings > Customization is the only location for Platform visuals: Icons or 3D Models, Icon card size, 3D model size, and 3D Models Folder. PlatformVisualStyle and both scale settings persist across restarts. Huymaier Console creates %LOCALAPPDATA%\Huymaier Console\3D Models with a README listing the exact 36 original Huymaier model-pack filenames and also recognizes a portable 3D Models folder beside HuymaierConsole.ps1. Games platform/provider cards begin from the normal icon card; when 3D Models is selected and a matching user GLB exists, the final user-model runtime replaces the icon host with real live x64 WPF Viewport3D geometry. Missing GLBs keep the normal icon; no static atlas snapshot is used by the final presentation. Customization reports the detected GLB count. X/Square opens the live model viewer with rotation/zoom while A/Cross continues to open the platform. Normal release bytes contain zero bundled GLBs and the staged model gate proves the packaged live DLL can load, rotate, zoom and scale a temporary real GLB. Browser cursor ownership is native-only: HuymaierWebBrowser.ps1 must contain no HUYMAIER_BROWSER_VIRTUAL_CURSOR_V1 or hc-virtual-cursor DOM implementation, the retired Optimize-ControllerBrowserCursor.ps1 transform is not invoked, and HuymaierUnifiedCursor.ps1 loads after WebBrowser and Customization. Both general and streaming staged validators now require HUYMAIER_UNIFIED_CURSOR_RUNTIME_V2, final load order, stale-node cleanup and native-system-cursor ownership while explicitly treating the old DOM/RAF cursor path as retired. Preserve all prior v0.26.5 GameCube, downloads, native streaming, Sony Raw-HID, Game Bar, Wii/Dolphin, provider concurrency, installer rollback/tamper, Steam/Nintendo ownership, performance and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Upload only if source plus release-shaped native-cursor, user-model, no-bundled-GLB and all inherited gates succeed together.
